params.body:
The offer's default for Intelligence goes from `contact: true` to `contact: false`: gentells.com now sells it with a checkout like Signal and Decode (the site change is a separate pull request on gentells-site). The "By conversation" box on the Settings page still makes any plan a conversation.

Full suite 1494 of 1500; the six failures are report-render, which needs pdftoppm on the machine that ran it.
params.title: plans: Intelligence is no longer by conversation by default
